intro.title: Arvand, from a small workshop to today
intro.body: Arvand began as a small carpentry workshop in Tehran, built on one rule that has never changed: nothing leaves the line until it's right. More than a decade on, that same discipline — patient and exacting — still guides every weld, cut and stitch we make.

philosophy.title: Design philosophy
philosophy.body: We believe comfort is never accidental. Every curve is shaped by years of seated-posture research, every material is chosen to outlast trends, and every joint is built so a worn part is a five-minute fix, not a reason to buy a new chair. Precision isn't a finish we add at the end — it's the discipline we start with.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: Arvand respects the privacy of its users and customers. This document explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what choices you have over it.

body.text: This Privacy Policy explains what information Arvand ("we", "Arvand") collects when you use our website and related services, how we use it, and the choices you have for controlling your information.
By using this website, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this document. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, please refrain from using the website.
We may collect the following information as you use the website:

items: Identity and contact details, such as name, phone number, email address and company name, when you fill in the contact form or a quote request.
Order and project information, such as the products you're interested in, quantities and delivery address.
Technical information, such as IP address, browser type, pages visited and time of visit, collected through cookies and analytics tools.
Information you voluntarily share with us through support requests or social media.

body.text: Collected information is used for the following purposes:

items: Responding to quote requests and messages submitted through the contact form.
Processing and following up on orders and corporate projects.
Improving the performance, content and usability of the website.
Notifying you about products or important changes, where you have consented to this.
Complying with legal requirements and responding to competent authorities where required.

body.text: The Arvand website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your language preference, analyze traffic and improve performance. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings; note that disabling some cookies may affect how the website functions.
Arvand does not sell your personal information. Information may only be shared with third parties in the following cases:

items: With logistics and shipping partners, solely for order delivery.
With technical service providers (such as website hosting or analytics tools) who are bound by confidentiality obligations.
Where required by law or requested by a competent authority.

body.text: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, disclosure or misuse. However, no method of transmission or storage over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
At any time, you may:

items: Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information.
Ask us to stop sending you promotional communications.
Ask us to explain how your information is being used.

body.text: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details at the end of this page.
We retain your information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy or as required by law. After that, information is securely deleted or de-identified.

Arvand's services are designed for corporate and adult audiences, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If you believe your child has submitted information without your consent, please contact us so we can remove it.

Arvand may update this policy from time to time. Any change will be published with an updated "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the website after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
